1323|877c4b1d.name: Osric Strang
1323|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

237|7ae4f953.name: Farmer Furlbrow
237|7ae4f953.text: Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

267007|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

392|9183bb21.name: Captain Grayson
392|9183bb21.text: Do not be alarmed, $r.  I have long since passed from this land but I intend no harm to your kind.  I have witnessed too much death in my time.  My only wish now is for peace.  Perhaps you can help my cause.

464|8234ebcf.name: Guard Parker
464|8234ebcf.text: Hail, $C.  Ill times these are, my friend, for our town is besieged!  The Blackrock Orcs attack from Stonewatch Keep, the Shadowhides loom over the Tower of Ilgalar, and the Redridge Gnoll Pack gathers strength.  I hope you're not here for a holiday...

491|02f3f1d4.name: Quartermaster Lewis
491|02f3f1d4.text: I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.

5111|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
5111|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6569|58cd03a1.name: Gnoarn
6569|58cd03a1.text:
Where Troggs and Leper Gnomes roam stands our home - Gnomeregan.

Our families lost, our homes displaced. Scattered.

Oh how I long for the days of carefree Gnomeregan life, but those days are no more. We must make our stand! We must save Gnomeregan!

6727|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6737|41276936.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

8965|bb0bc8e7.name: Shawn
8965|bb0bc8e7.text: Hello there ma'am... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

1003-progress.name: Unknown
1003-progress.text:
You hear singing coming from Buzzbox 525.

"Though crawler wine's shweet, and thresher ale fine, and moonstalker moonshine ish grand. There's nothing sho dear, as a thistle bear beer, and shoon I shall have shome on hand!"

The hatch is open and awaits the 4 grizzled scalps as you hear the song repeated over and over.
1003-progress.title: Buzzbox 525

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

103-progress.name: Captain Grayson
103-progress.text: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
103-progress.title: Keeper of the Flame

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

4812-progress.name: Unknown
4812-progress.text: The crystal looks very alien against the wooded scenery of Darkshore.  You think you hear a very slight humming coming from deep within it.
4812-progress.title: As Water Cascades

6181-progress.name: Thor
6181-progress.text: You look like you're in a hurry.  Well, then you came to the right place!
6181-progress.title: A Swift Message

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom
